2.name: F02
2.solution: Check whether the PV is grounded, secondly, check whether the impedance of the PV to the ground is normal.
2.solution_ru: Проверьте заземление PV и сопротивление изоляции относительно земли.

3.name: F03
3.solution: 1. Check whether the PV modules are grounded. 2. Check whether the impedance of the PV to the ground is normal, whether there is leakage current.
3.solution_ru: 1. Проверьте заземление модулей PV. 2. Проверьте сопротивление изоляции и наличие утечки.

4.name: F04
4.solution: Check whether the PV is grounded.

5.name: F05
5.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.
5.solution_ru: Перезапустите инвертор 3 раза и выполните сброс к заводским настройкам.

6.name: F06
6.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.
6.solution_ru: Перезапустите инвертор 3 раза и выполните сброс к заводским настройкам.

7.name: F07
7.solution: The BUS voltage can't be reached by PV or battery. 1. Switch off the DC switches and restart the inverter.
7.solution_ru: Напряжение шины не достигается. Отключите DC и перезапустите инвертор.

8.name: F08
8.solution: The BUS voltage can't be reached by PV or battery. 1. Switch off the DC switches and restart the inverter.
8.solution_ru: Напряжение шины не достигается. Отключите DC и перезапустите инвертор.

9.name: F09
9.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.
9.solution_ru: Перезапустите инвертор 3 раза и выполните сброс.

10.name: F10
10.solution: 1. First check whether the inverter switch is open. 2. Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.
10.solution_ru: 1. Проверьте включение инвертора. 2. Перезапустите и сбросьте настройки.

11.name: F11
11.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.
11.solution_ru: Перезапустите инвертор 3 раза и выполните сброс.

12.name: F12
12.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.
12.solution_ru: Перезапустите инвертор 3 раза и выполните сброс.

13.name: F13
13.solution: 1. When the grid type and frequency have changed it will report F13. 2. When the battery mode has been changed to 'No battery' mode, it will report F13. 3. For some old FW version, it will report F13 when the system's work mode has been changed. 4. Generally, this error will disappear automatically. 5. If it remains the same, turn off DC and AC switches for one minute, then turn on the DC and AC switches.
13.solution_ru: Возникает при смене типа сети или режима батареи. Обычно исчезает автоматически. При необходимости — перезапуск AC/DC.

14.name: F14
14.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.
14.solution_ru: Перезапустите инвертор 3 раза и выполните сброс.

15.name: F15
15.solution: AC side over current fault. 1. Please check whether the backup load power and common load power are within the range. 2. Restart and check whether it is normal.
15.solution_ru: Проверьте мощность нагрузки (backup и общую). Перезапустите и проверьте.

16.name: F16
16.solution: Leakage current fault. 1. Check the PV side cable ground connection. 2. Restart the system 2-3 times.
16.solution_ru: Проверьте заземление PV и перезапустите систему 2–3 раза.

17.name: F17
17.solution: 1. Check the PV connection and whether the PV is unstable. 2. Restart the inverter 3 times.
17.solution_ru: Проверьте подключение PV и стабильность. Перезапустите.

18.name: F18
18.solution: AC side over current fault. 1. Please check whether the backup load power and common load power are within the range. 2. Restart and check whether it is normal.

19.name: F19
19.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.

20.name: F20
20.solution: DC side over current fault 1. Check PV module connection and battery connection; 2. When in the off-grid mode, starting the inverter under a high power load may report F20. Please reduce the load power connected. 3. If it remains the same, turn off DC and AC switches for one minute, then turn on the DC and AC switches.
20.solution_ru: Проверьте PV и батарею, уменьшите нагрузку, перезапустите.

21.name: F21
21.solution: BUS over current 1. Check the PV input current and battery current setting. 2. Restart the system 2~3 times.
21.solution_ru: Проверьте ток PV и батареи, перезапустите.

22.name: F22
22.solution: Remotely shutdown It means the inverter is remotely controlled.

23.name: F23
23.solution: Leakage current fault 1. Check PV side cable ground connection. 2. Restart the system 2~3 times.

24.name: F24
24.solution: PV isolation resistance is too low 1. Check the connection of PV panels and inverter is firm and correct. 2. Check whether the PE cable of inverter is connected to ground.

25.name: F25
25.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.

26.name: F26
26.solution: 1. Please wait for a while and check whether it is normal. 2. When the load power of 3 phases has a big different, it will report the F26. 3. When there's DC leakage current, it will report F26. 4. Restart the system 2~3 times.
26.solution_ru: Проверьте нагрузку фаз и утечки, перезапустите.

27.name: F27
27.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.

28.name: F28
28.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.

29.name: F29
29.solution: 1. When inverters are connected in parallel, check the parallel communication cable connection and hybrid inverter communication address setting. 2. During the parallel system startup period, inverters will report F29. But when all inverters are in ON status, it will disappear automatically.
29.solution_ru: Проверьте кабели и адреса. Обычно исчезает после запуска.

30.name: F30
30.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.

31.name: F31
31.solution: 1. Check whether the grid orientation is correct, 2. Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings

32.name: F32
32.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.

33.name: F33
33.solution: 1. Check whether the grid current is too large. 2. Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.

34.name: F34
34.solution: Check the backup load connection, make sure it is within the allowed power range.

35.name: F35
35.solution: Check the grid voltage and frequency, whether the connection of the power grid is normal.

39.name: F39
39.solution: Inverter AC overcurrent, restart the inverter.

40.name: F40
40.solution: Inverter DC overcurrent, restart the inverter.

41.name: F41
41.solution: Check the hybrid inverter work status. If there is at least one hybrid inverter shutdown, all hybrid inverters will report F41 fault.

42.name: F42
42.solution: 1. Check whether the inverter version is consistent. 2. Please contact us to upgrade the software version.
42.solution_ru: Проверьте версии ПО, при необходимости обновите.

45.name: F45
45.solution: Grid voltage out of range. 1. Check the voltage is in the range of specification or not. 2. Check whether AC cables are firmly and correctly connected.

46.name: F46
46.solution: Grid voltage out of range. 1. Check the voltage is in the range of specification or not. 2. Check whether AC cables are firmly and correctly connected.

47.name: F47
47.solution: Grid frequency out of range. 1. Check whether the frequency is in the range of the specification or not. 2. Check whether AC cables are firmly and correctly connected.

48.name: F48
48.solution: Grid frequency out of range. 1. Check whether the frequency is in the range of the specification or not. 2. Check whether AC cables are firmly and correctly connected.

49.name: F49
49.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.

50.name: F50
50.solution: Restart the inverter 3 times and restore the factory settings.

51.name: F51
51.solution: Check whether the temperature data of BMS is too high.

52.name: F52
52.solution: BUS voltage is too high. 1. Check whether battery voltage is too high. 2. Check the PV input voltage, make sure if it is within the allowed range.

53.name: F53
53.solution: BUS voltage is too low. 1. Check whether battery voltage is too low. 2. If the battery voltage is too low, use PV or grid to charge the battery.

54.name: F54
54.solution: 1. Check the battery 2 terminal voltage is high. 2. Restart the inverter 2 times and restore the factory settings.

55.name: F55
55.solution: 1. Check the battery 1 terminal voltage is high. 2. Restart the inverter 2 times and restore the factory settings.

56.name: F56
56.solution: 1. Check the battery 1 terminal voltage is low. 2. Restart the inverter 2 times and restore the factory settings.

57.name: F57
57.solution: 1. Check the battery 2 terminal voltage is low. 2. Restart the inverter 2 times and restore the factory settings.

58.name: F58
58.solution: 1. It means that the communication between the hybrid inverter and the battery BMS is disconnected when 'BMS_Err-Stop' is active. 2. To avoid this error, disable 'BMS_Err-Stop' item on the LCD.
58.solution_ru: Проверьте связь с BMS или отключите BMS_Err-Stop.

60.name: F60
60.solution: Check whether the voltage and frequency of the generator are normal, and then restart.

61.name: F61
61.solution: Check whether the switch of the inverter is turned on, restart the inverter, and restore the factory settings.

62.name: F62
62.solution: Check the DRM function is active or not.

63.name: F63
63.solution: 1. ARC fault detection is only for US market. 2. Check PV module cable connection and clear the fault.
63.solution_ru: Проверьте кабели PV и устраните неисправность.

64.name: F64
64.solution: Heat sink temperature is too high. 1. Check whether the working environment temperature is too high. 2. Turn off the inverter for 10 minutes and restart.
64.solution_ru: Проверьте температуру окружающей среды и перезапустите через 10 минут.

1.name: W01
1.solution: 1. Check the operating status of the fan. 2. If the fan is running abnormally, open the cover of the inverter to check the connection of the fan.
1.solution_ru: 1. Проверьте работу вентилятора. 2. Если вентилятор работает некорректно, откройте крышку инвертора и проверьте подключение вентилятора.

2.name: W02
2.solution: 1. Check the operating status of the fan. 2. If the fan is running abnormally, open the cover of the inverter to check the connection of the fan.
2.solution_ru: 1. Проверьте работу вентилятора. 2. Если вентилятор работает некорректно, откройте крышку инвертора и проверьте подключение вентилятора.

3.name: W03
3.solution: 1. Check the phase sequence connection of the power grid. 2. Try to change the grid type, 0, 240/120. 3. If there is still no solution to check the wiring at the grid end.
3.solution_ru: 1. Проверьте последовательность фаз в сети. 2. Попробуйте изменить тип сети (0, 240/120). 3. Если не помогло — проверьте подключение на стороне сети.

4.name: W04
4.solution: Meter communication failure. Check whether the meter has successful communication and whether the wiring is normal.
4.solution_ru: Ошибка связи со счётчиком. Проверьте наличие связи и корректность подключения.

5.name: W05
5.solution: Check whether the arrow on CT's case point to the inverter or not, and check if the installation location of CTs are correct.
5.solution_ru: Проверьте, направлена ли стрелка на корпусе трансформатора тока к инвертору и правильно ли установлены CT.

6.name: W06
6.solution: Check whether the wires of CTs are connected correctly or not.
6.solution_ru: Проверьте правильность подключения проводов трансформаторов тока.

7.name: W07
7.solution: Check whether the FAN are connected correctly and operating normally.
7.solution_ru: Проверьте правильность подключения и работу вентилятора.

8.name: W08
8.solution: Check whether the FAN are connected correctly and operating normally.
8.solution_ru: Проверьте правильность подключения и работу вентилятора.

9.name: W09
9.solution: 1. Measure whether the grid port voltage is too high. 2. Check whether the AC cable is too thin to carry current.
9.solution_ru: 1. Проверьте, не слишком ли высокое напряжение сети. 2. Убедитесь, что AC-кабель достаточного сечения.

10.name: W10
10.solution: Check whether the FAN are connected correctly and operating normally.
10.solution_ru: Проверьте правильность подключения и работу вентилятора.

11.name: W11
11.solution: This is a critical warning that requires checking the solar panel or battery connections. Main causes and actions: Check panel/battery voltage: Make sure that the PV (solar panel) or battery voltage is within the inverter's operating range. Reboot: Try to completely turn off the inverter (AC and DC), wait 10-15 minutes until the screen turns off, and then turn it on again. Check cables: Inspect the terminals for looseness or oxidation. Service center: If the W11/F11 error persists after reboot, contact the installer or service center.
11.solution_ru: Критическое предупреждение. Проверьте подключение солнечных панелей или батареи. Основные действия: проверьте напряжение PV/АКБ (должно быть в диапазоне работы инвертора); выполните перезапуск (полностью отключите AC и DC, подождите 10–15 минут, затем включите); проверьте кабели на ослабление и окисление; если ошибка не исчезает — обратитесь в сервис.

31.name: W31
31.solution: Abnormal battery communication. 1. Check whether the BMS connection is stable. 2. Check whether the BMS data is abnormal.
31.solution_ru: Ошибка связи с батареей. 1. Проверьте стабильность соединения BMS. 2. Проверьте корректность данных BMS.

32.name: W32
32.solution: Unstable parallel communication. 1. Check the connection of the parallel communication line. Please do not wind the parallel communication line with other cables. 2. Check whether the parallel dip switch is on.
32.solution_ru: Нестабильная параллельная связь. 1. Проверьте кабель параллельной связи (не прокладывайте вместе с силовыми). 2. Проверьте DIP-переключатели.
